delivery: One source-only submissions/<folder> module with tests and documented behavior; unchanged ABI/host; no GUI/devices.
review: Local host/Windows integration and review required even after kit tests pass.
name: Noise
behavior: White noise first; additional colours are a later enhancement, not an undocumented substitute.
Use fixed documented integer PRNG state per instance (no OS RNG); reset returns to the documented seed.
Map to bipolar raw audio, Level uses 5ms shared ramp; initial/reset snaps.
No per-sample allocations, locks or denormal-producing recursive state.
acceptance: Identical sequence across process partitions and reset, independent instances.
At level1, fixed-seed sample bounds, mean near0 and variance near1/3 with broad deterministic tolerances over a documented sample count.
Level0 produces exact zero after ramp, and no host 0.2 output gain is applied here.
